reason: Applies both needs-stale judgements for this prediction. First, the monetization Need delivered: bridge validation.ba0458d65e61f6a6 (2026-07-18) records the credit-gated shape landing in full from July 20 - the flagship stays in the top two tiers at half limits while the lower tiers get a one-time $100 usage credit and then pay API rates - so that Need is historical and its successor is written forward to defending the band under undercutting. Second, the rival-pricing Need was empirically inverted rather than merely unmet: validation.6a7e29b7ba6fb0a8 (2026-07-10) shows the named actors listing flagships at $5/$30 and $1.25 inside the Need's own window, so its motivation that a premium launch gives cover to lift prices no longer holds. Both are re-cut around the monetization shape rivals are actually adopting - volume rationing and credit-gating of a premium tier - so the Need-set tracks a live question. The rival Need's when text is carried over verbatim; that runway did not change.
